name: Cabo Verde
summary: Cabo Verde taxes residents on worldwide income. Capital gains on shares and real estate are taxed at a flat 1%, Cabo Verdean dividends at a flat 10%, and foreign income goes into the declared income taxed at 16.5-27.5% with a credit for foreign tax. There is no wealth tax, inheritance or gift tax; inherited or donated Cabo Verdean real estate bears the 1% municipal transfer tax (ITI). A property-ownership tax (IPI) of 0.1% replaced the old IUP from 2026.

regimes.name: Cabo Verde tax resident
regimes.description: Worldwide PIT; flat 1% on capital gains, 10% on dividends; foreign income at 16.5-27.5%.
regimes.eligibility: Resident on more than 183 days in the calendar year, or a dwelling at 31 December suggesting habitual residence. Non-nationals need a residence permit.

capital_gains.summary: Capital gains of individuals on the disposal of immovable property, intellectual property or shareholdings are taxed at a flat 1% (Category E, final withholding method). Foreign income of residents is taxed under the declarative method at 16.5-27.5%; whether foreign share gains stay at the flat 1% or are taxed at those rates was not established.

sources.title: Cabo Verde - Individual - Taxes on personal income

open_questions: Rate on a resident's gains on foreign securities and foreign property (1% flat or progressive 16.5-27.5%).
capital_gains.rate_basis: Category E flat 1% for domestic listed shares, private company shares and Cabo Verde real estate. Foreign listed shares and foreign real estate: null (1% or 16.5-27.5% under the declarative method).
capital_gains.professional_trader: Habitual dealing would be Category B business income at the PIT rates.
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Worldwide taxation; credit for foreign tax up to the Cabo Verde tax on that income.
capital_gains.important_exceptions: From 1 January 2026 the IUP (which also taxed certain real estate gains) was repealed and replaced by IPI/ITI; real estate transfer tax ITI 1% on acquisitions.

dividends.summary: Dividends are investment income (Category D) taxed at a flat 10%. Income obtained abroad by residents is taxed under the declarative method at 16.5% to 27.5% with a credit for foreign tax up to the Cabo Verde tax.

sources.title: Cabo Verde - Individual - Taxes on personal income
Cabo Verde - Individual - Foreign tax relief and tax treaties

open_questions: Whether foreign dividends can instead be taxed at the 10% Category D flat rate.
dividends.rate_basis: Domestic 10% flat. Foreign: top declarative rate 27.5% (above CVE 1.8 million) before credit.
dividends.withholding_outbound: 10% on dividends (Category D rate; non-residents taxed at the same flat rates).
dividends.treaty_network: Only three treaties: Portugal, Guinea-Bissau and Macau. US and most EU dividends would bear full statutory source WHT.
dividends.holding_company_notes: CIT 20% plus fire-brigade surtax (not verified); worldwide basis.

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: From 1 January 2026: IPI (property-ownership tax) 0.1% of taxable value (0.15% land), replacing the 1.5% IUP; ITI transfer tax 1% (3% if a party uses a privileged tax regime).

inheritance.summary: No inheritance or gift tax was found. From 2026, ITI (municipal real estate transfer tax) of 1% applies to free transfers by death or donation of Cabo Verde real estate, paid by the acquirer. Movable property such as securities is not covered by ITI.
open_questions: Whether the Stamp Duty Code taxes gratuitous acquisitions (inheritance/gifts) of movables.
inheritance.gift_tax: No gift tax found; 1% ITI on donated Cabo Verde real estate.
inheritance.important_exceptions: Stamp duty on gratuitous transfers (as in Portugal's model) was not found in PwC's stamp duty table but was not ruled out.

residency.tax_residency_test: More than 183 days in aggregate in the calendar year, or fewer days with a dwelling at 31 December suggesting habitual residence (PwC).

routes.name: Residence permit
routes.requirements: Non-nationals need a residence permit; investor-residence options exist but were not verified in this session.

corporate.summary: CIT 20% on worldwide profits of resident companies; micro and small companies pay a 4% single special tax on turnover.

sources.title: Cabo Verde - Corporate - Taxes on corporate income

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain fully US-taxed on worldwide income and estates; the app adds the US federal layer. No US-Cabo Verde income tax treaty.
open_questions: The 1% capital gains rate is low enough that its scope for foreign assets matters greatly; it should be confirmed in the PIT Code.
